lastCompletedStory.title: Add the pure early-death detector over a session transcript

openQuestions: This story adds ONLY the pure predicate + probe factory (classifyEarlyDeath, extractLastAssistantEntry, isTransientApiError, makeEarlyDeathProbe, EARLY_DEATH_FLOOR_MS) in src/supervisor/early-death.ts. Nothing calls makeEarlyDeathProbe from the poll loop yet, and nothing sets DispatchFailureReason='session-died-early' or the VerifiedDispatchOptions.cause field (US-001, CAM-479) from a real detected death. Wiring the probe into the actual poll loop (loop.ts, likely alongside the existing perWorkerTimeoutMs/isPaneAlive checks) and threading its verdict into runVerifiedDispatch's cause/reason is the next story's job.
nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-479) added src/supervisor/early-death.ts: a pure two-layer early-death detector over a worker session transcript. Layer 1 (pure, no I/O): `classifyEarlyDeath({previousSample, currentSample, jsonl, floorMs?})` returns `{verdict:'dead-on-first-turn', cause}` only when BOTH the transcript's byte size has not grown across the floor window (EARLY_DEATH_FLOOR_MS=60_000ms, proven far below both DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS=30min and DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS=60min from loop.ts) AND the transcript's last assistant entry (`extractLastAssistantEntry`) is a transient API error (`isTransientApiError`: checks the real `isApiErrorMessage:true` transcript-line flag first, falls back to a local `/^API Error:.*(5\d{2}|overloaded|rate.?limit|timeout|...)/is` regex on the verbatim text) -- otherwise `{verdict:'still-working'}`. `cause` is the last assistant entry's verbatim text (not synthesized). Layer 2 (stateful): `makeEarlyDeathProbe({cwd, claudeDir, readFileFn?, nowFn?, floorMs?})` returns a `(uuid) => EarlyDeathVerdict` closure that resolves the transcript path via the EXISTING shared `transcriptPathForSession` (src/transcript/usage.ts, no second resolver), tracks the last byte-size sample per uuid in a closure-local Map, and reports still-working (clearing any stale sample) whenever the file is absent or the reader throws -- a resolver miss can never fabricate a death. Two REAL fixtures back the tests: test/fixtures/early-death/dead-on-first-turn.jsonl (8 entries, ~3.1KB, exactly one assistant entry which IS the `isApiErrorMessage:true` 529-Overloaded error) and healthy-planner.jsonl (67 entries, ~258KB, 16 tool_use blocks, real multi-turn thinking/text/tool_use/tool_result shape). Every test drives an injected clock (`nowFn`) or explicit timestamps, never wall time. Next story (per handoff openQuestions) wires this probe into the actual poll loop and into US-001's `cause`/`session-died-early` vocabulary on verified-dispatch.ts.
